title: Manager: a park reason for a merge the hook refuses because its checks could not run
item: Map the merge hook's refusal 'the merge checks could not run' to a park reason in commands/manage.md step 7 and in the hook's message
motivation: Found by task 68's review (tasks/reviews/068-3.md, outside finding); the gap existed before task 68's branch and it did not change it.
notes: When the hook refuses a task merge because the merge checks could not run (scripts/checks.py, push_hook), neither its message nor commands/manage.md step 7 names a park reason, so the manager has no word to give checks.py consult. Which of the four reasons fits is the owner's call.
draft_note: Proposed by the manager on 2026-11-20 in task 68's merge, from the reviewer's outside finding on earlier files (SKILL.md rule 2).

outside_problems.problem: The merge hook's refusal when the merge checks could not run (around lines 963-964 of task 68's branch) names no park reason.
Step 7's mapping of hook refusals to park reasons has no case for 'the merge checks could not run'.
